name: Joseph
overview: Joseph was a male member of the tribe of Issachar known primarily as the father of Igal. Beyond this familial role, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or notes about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Joseph, meaning 'he will add,' is the only recorded name for this individual. This proper name does not appear to have been given directly by God in this instance.
familyAndRelationships: Joseph is identified as the father of Igal and a descendant of the tribe of Issachar. These relationships are inferred from the scriptural record and establish his place within the tribal lineage.
scriptureSignificance: Joseph holds significance in the biblical narrative as a tribal figure linked to Issachar through his son Igal. While not to be confused with other biblical Josephs, his mention underscores the continuity of Israel's tribal families and their roles in God's unfolding plan.

keyEvents.event: Sold into slavery by his brothers
